output.headline: Some charges may not be fully paid by your insurance because of room limits and non-payable items.
what_happened: Your hospital bill includes charges for your room, surgery, and care during your stay.
Insurance companies review bills against policy limits before paying them.
Your policy has specific rules about room rent, non-payable items, and your share of the cost.
why: The insurer expects deductions because the room category you chose is higher than your policy's limit.
Certain items like laundry and personal comforts are classified as non-payable items under policy rules.
Your policy also includes a co-payment share that applies to admissible claim amounts.
next_steps: Speak with the hospital billing desk to understand the exact breakdown of charges.
Ask if choosing a different room category is possible to reduce extra costs.
Keep all your policy papers and hospital bills safely together.
Check with the hospital desk before paying any difference out of pocket.
output.reassurance: We are looking closely at every detail to help you understand your bill. Arzi will help review your documents carefully.
